product_one_liner.value: Scandit helps frontline workers and businesses automate workflows by capturing barcodes, text, objects and IDs with AI on smart devices.
product_one_liner.notes: Scandit describes AI-powered capture of barcodes, text, objects and IDs on smart devices, automating workflows for frontline workers and improving customer experiences. Source: https://www.scandit.com/about

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes fixed and flexible pricing options and included support. Source: https://www.scandit.com/pricing

employee_band.notes: The company profile records 363 employees, placing Scandit in the 201–500 band. The headcount observation date is unspecified. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/scandit/__yXMjlFmCS5vkAzitaQLiKzs8ys2cklDrsKwMaxoOGLc

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Scandit explicitly identifies Zurich as its global headquarters city. Source: https://www.scandit.com/company | hq_country: The company page labels Zurich, Switzerland as its global headquarters. Source: https://www.scandit.com/company

founded_year.notes: Scandit’s company page explicitly states that it was founded in 2009. Source: https://www.scandit.com/company

eng_blog.notes: Two CTO-authored technical posts explain product implementation: shared ML models and codebases, and ShelfView’s cloud-processing architecture and VLM alert validation. They qualify by technical content, although hosted within the main company blog rather than a separate engineering publication. Sources: https://www.scandit.com/blog/take-a-look-inside-the-scandit-ai-engine and https://scandit.com/blog/how-the-scandit-vision-ai-engine-makes-shelf-technology-smarter/

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal links multiple product guides, including SparkScan, Barcode Capture and MatrixScan Batch, rather than only a single FAQ. Sources: https://docs.scandit.com/ and https://docs.scandit.com/sdks/ios/agent-skills/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is for Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Biometrics & Face Recognition), a qualifying ML role. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_app?for=scandit&token=8264704

model_provider.value: Scandit’s own machine-learning and computer-vision models, delivered through the Scandit Vision AI Engine.
model_provider.notes: Scandit names its Vision AI Engine as the product’s intelligence layer and describes 'our models' supplied to customers as trained models. This supports Scandit as the provider of its own ML/CV models, but does not identify an individual model architecture or external supplier. Source: https://www.scandit.com/blog/take-a-look-inside-the-scandit-ai-engine

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page claims ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a requested compliance claim, not represented as a certification.
